answer: Treat endorsement as flow in an eigenvector sense: trust leaks in only from the established core and splits among everyone a node points to. A ring of fakes endorsing each other is a sealed vault with no inlet — rank circulates internally and never fills, like water trapped in shale the river never reaches. Honest identities sit on real inbound paths from the core and accrue steady weight. No amount of mutual whisper among sybil heads injects outside rank, so the cluster's total influence stays near zero however large it grows.
